notes.v1_03: Satellite: Make the gold foil body smooth with only two or three broad soft folds, and make the dish soft satin silver instead of mirror chrome. Make the orange rings slightly softer and less saturated, and give the satellite a slightly cool shadow side on its right.
notes.v1_07: Star Map: Paint the chart a slightly lighter mid blue with soft lighter and darker fold panels, and remove the speckled noise. Make the compass warm brass with a small soft shine. Keep the stars and the wooden table.
notes.v1_05: Spaceship: Paint the hull glossy white with a red stripe along the side, and make the engine nozzles dark blue-grey metal. Replace the lime studio gradient with an even, mid-tone green background, and put a short soft shadow right under the ship. Light from the upper left so the underside and right flank are clearly darker.
notes.v1_09: Control Panel: Make the wall one plain, slightly deeper warm yellow surface with no rivets, vents or seams, and make the floor smooth and plain. Light from the upper left so the right side of the console and the undersides of the buttons are slightly darker. Keep the screen, dial and levers.
notes.v1_06: Rover: Make the body matte white with a few soft panel seams and an orange stripe, and keep only a thin highlight along its top edge. Make the sand a smooth, slightly deeper warm ochre. Give the rover's right side and the wheels a clear cool blue-grey shadow side.
notes.v1_04: Space Gloves: Paint the gloves a neutral light grey-white with cool grey shadows instead of purple-tinted ones. Even out the purple background with only a gentle darkening at the corners. Keep the orange cuffs and the teal patches.
